title: Preferences
description: How OpenBot looks and behaves for you. Message list preferences sync with your account. Theme is saved in this browser.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.description: Buy this deployment's plan with Alipay or WeChat Pay. An administrator starts a purchase; everybody reads the result here.
subscribe.notEnabled: Purchases are not available on this deployment. No payment channel has been configured.
subscribe.notAdmin: Only an administrator can start a purchase. The catalog is shown read-only.
subscribe.noPlans: No plan is purchasable here yet. An administrator configures the plan catalog.
subscribe.plansDescription: One plan at a time: a new plan can only be bought while no subscription is active.
subscribe.providerDescription: The channel to pay through. The order is created on that channel only.
subscribe.checkoutDescription: The order for “{{planCode}}” is waiting for payment.
subscribe.qrFailed: The QR code could not be drawn. Cancel the order and start again.
subscribe.statusPaid: Payment received. Your plan is active.
subscribe.statusPaidActivating: Payment received. Your plan is being set up — this finishes on its own.
subscribe.statusPaidFailed: Payment was received, but the plan could not be set up. Ask an administrator to check the payment records.
subscribe.statusCanceled: This order was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
subscribe.statusExpired: This order expired before payment arrived. Start again for a new code.
subscribe.statusBlocked: This payment could not be verified and the order was stopped. Ask an administrator to check the payment records.

usagePage.title: Plans & usage
usagePage.description: What this deployment has used of its plan: how much of each resource, how much is left, and when it resets.
usagePage.noSubscription: There is no active subscription to measure usage against.
usagePage.eventLogDescription: Each metered model call, newest first — the line items behind the numbers above.
usagePage.trendTruncated: Chart covers the most recent {{total}} events only
usagePage.chartEmpty: No daily usage in this period yet.
usagePage.overviewDescription: Each resource in the current billing period. A resource with no configured ceiling is metered, not capped.
usagePage.noQuotas: Nothing has been used in this period yet.
usagePage.meteredOnly: Metered — this deployment set no ceiling

darkThemeDescription: Use the dark appearance across OpenBot.

language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. Falls back to English for anything not yet translated.

gallery.title: Components gallery
gallery.description: The pieces a Bot can draw in a conversation instead of describing something in prose. Which of them any one Bot may use is an administrator's decision.
gallery.emptyDescription: When an administrator publishes a component, it will show up here.
gallery.missingDescription: Nothing here answers to that name.
gallery.missingEmpty: It may have been withdrawn, or this deployment may no longer ship it.

connectedAccounts.title: Connected accounts
connectedAccounts.description: Connect your apps so your Bots can work with them.
connectedAccounts.connectFailed: That account could not be connected. Nothing was saved — try again.
connectedAccounts.loadError: Your connected accounts could not be loaded, so nothing is listed here rather than a list that may be wrong. Reload the page, and tell an administrator if it persists.
connectedAccounts.empty: Nothing to connect yet. These appear once an administrator enables a connector that reads as the person asking.
connectedAccounts.sharedDescription: Shared by your organisation. Bots act as the team account.
connectedAccounts.connectionLoadError: Whether you have connected this account could not be loaded, so nothing about it is shown here rather than something that may be wrong. Reload the page, and tell an administrator if it persists.
connectedAccounts.connectorLoadError: This connector could not be loaded, so nothing about it is shown here rather than something that may be wrong. Reload the page, and tell an administrator if it persists.
connectedAccounts.noBotReads: No Bot can read this as you.
connectedAccounts.brokeredDescription: Reached through Composio, which holds the account, so a Bot sees only what you can see.
connectedAccounts.brokeredConnected: A Bot granted its tools reads your {{title}} as you. Disconnecting ends the account at Composio, not just here.
connectedAccounts.brokeredDisconnected: Connecting takes you to Composio and then to the vendor to consent.
connectedAccounts.notPersonal: This is not a service you connect for yourself.
connectedAccounts.deploymentCredential: A Bot reaches this one with a credential the deployment holds, the same for everybody.
connectedAccounts.noConnector: This deployment has no connector by that name.
connectedAccounts.notEnabled: An administrator has not enabled this connector, so there is nothing to connect to yet.
connectedAccounts.connectedDescription: A Bot granted its tools reads this as you, and sees only what you can see.
connectedAccounts.disconnectedDescription: No Bot can read this as you. Connecting takes you to the vendor to consent.
connectedAccounts.noConsentLink: This deployment answered without a consent link, so there was nowhere to send you and nothing was connected. Try again, and tell an administrator if it persists.
connectedAccounts.disconnectNotBuilt: Disconnecting is not built yet. Until it is, revoke it in your {{vendor}} account's third-party access settings — that stops this deployment reading anything immediately.
connectedAccounts.accessDescription: What you agreed to, as the vendor recorded it — not what was asked for. The two differ when a consent screen is only partly accepted.
connectedAccounts.secretMasked: Masked. {{vendor}} holds the live credential; this deployment stores only a sealed copy.
connectedAccounts.revealAudited: Reading the secret in the clear is an action of its own, authorized separately from using the connection, and every read is written to the audit log.

passwords.title: Passwords
passwords.description: Logins you saved when signing a Bot in to a website. A Bot never sees them, and each use needs your confirmation.
passwords.disabled: Saved passwords are turned off for this workspace. Existing logins are kept but not offered.
passwords.empty: No saved logins. Choose Save to Passwords when you sign a Bot in to a website.

messageList.title: Message list emphasis
messageList.description: Choose which name appears larger in the sidebar.

instructions.title: Standing instructions
instructions.description: Applies to every coworker in every channel. Your role text on a coworker says what it does; this says how you want things done, for example writing style or how to describe your company.
instructions.placeholder: We are two people, not a team. Write in British English, and never call our product a platform.

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Sign in to the OpenBot app on your phone and turn on notifications to add it here.

githubSources.title: GitHub events
githubSources.description: Register a repository, then add its webhook in GitHub using the address below and the same secret. A responsibility can then start on one of its events, such as issues.opened.
githubSources.secretHint: Use the same secret when you add the webhook in GitHub.

linkedAccounts.title: Linked accounts
linkedAccounts.loadError: Your linked accounts could not be loaded: {{error}}
linkedAccounts.providersError: Could not check which accounts can be linked: {{error}}
linkedAccounts.slackCodeError: Could not create a Slack link code: {{error}}
linkedAccounts.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
linkedAccounts.codeExpiry: The code works once and expires in 10 minutes.

updateRouting.title: Where updates go
updateRouting.description: Where each kind of update goes when you are not looking. The web always shows everything.
updateRouting.loadError: Could not load where your updates go.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Replies and results from work you were not watching.

decision.title: Decisions
decision.description: Approvals a Bot needs before it acts.

question.title: Questions
question.description: Things a Bot asked you and is waiting on.

notificationsPage.title: Notifications
notificationsPage.description: Where updates from all your Bots reach you when you are not looking. How much each Bot sends is on its own page.

memoryPage.title: Memory
memoryPage.description: What your Bots know about you. Facts you tell them reach every Bot; what a Bot learns stays with that Bot.

teamBots.title: Bots shared with you
teamBots.description: A Bot someone shared with you uses their connected apps, and yours only where you allowed it on the card it showed you.
teamBots.forget: Forget them, so each asks again.

new-chat.label: New chat
new-chat.description: Start a new chat from anywhere in the app.

invoicesPage.title: Bills
invoicesPage.description: What this deployment has been billed. Bills are raised here and settled through Alipay or WeChat Pay; open one for its detail, or download it.
invoicesPage.emptyDescription: This deployment has not been billed for anything. Once a plan is purchased, its bills appear here.
invoicesPage.unavailableDescription: No billing provider is configured on this deployment, so there are no bills to show.

creditsPage.title: Plans & credits
creditsPage.description: View your subscription plan and billing information
creditsPage.personalAccountDescription: Your own account's credit balance, recorded against your authorizations.
creditsPage.emptyLedger: No credit records on this account yet.
creditsPage.rewardsDescription: Reward credits from campaigns and check-ins, soonest-to-lapse first.
creditsPage.consumptionDescription: Each credit this deployment spent, newest first.
creditsPage.unavailableDescription: No billing provider is configured on this deployment, so there are no credits to show.
creditsPage.emptyConsumption: No credit usage in that period.
creditsPage.purchaseEmpty: No credits yet. Purchases will appear here.
creditsPage.rewardsSummary: {{count}} rewards, {{remaining}} available ({{held}} held by in-progress calls)
creditsPage.overdrawHint: This call cost more than the balance could fund. The ledger records the full cost; {{shortfall}} was not covered by any grant.

pendingReasons.usage_missing: The call finished but its usage was never reported; it settles after the platform reconciles it.
pendingReasons.stream_error: The response failed midway, so the outcome is unknown; it settles after the platform reconciles it.
pendingReasons.cancelled: The call was interrupted, so the outcome is unknown; it settles after the platform reconciles it.
pendingReasons.usage_invalid: The reported usage cannot be priced; it awaits manual review.
pendingReasons.usage_over_bound: The reported usage exceeded the preset bound; it awaits manual review.
pendingReasons.usage_charge_failed: Recording the settlement failed; the platform will reconcile and settle it.
pendingReasons.dispatch_result_unknown: The model service's final result is unconfirmed; it settles or releases once the platform verifies it.
pendingReasons.hold_expired_without_result: The call timed out with no result; it settles or releases once the platform verifies it.
pendingReasons.provider_error: The model service refused before producing anything, so no charge was incurred.
pendingReasons.bound_refused: The call failed admission and never reached the model service, so no charge was incurred.
pendingReasons.no_usage: The model service reported zero usage for this call, so no charge was incurred.
pendingReasons.fallback: This call is still being reconciled; the figure updates when it completes.
pendingReasons.async_dispatch_answer_lost: The job's dispatch acknowledgement was lost; whether the provider took it is unconfirmed, and it settles or releases after the platform verifies it.
pendingReasons.async_cancel_result_unknown: The cancellation never received the provider's answer, so the outcome is unknown; it settles or releases after the platform verifies it.

creditsPage.pendingHandling: Pending amounts are held, not spent; the platform verifies the outcome with the model service and then settles or releases them automatically.
creditsPage.realtimeDescription: What each realtime session consumed, what awaits settlement, and why a session stopped
creditsPage.realtimeAbnormalFallback: This session is being reconciled and updates when it completes.
creditsPage.realtimeAbnormal_stopped_insufficient_cr: Stopped — the account balance ran out
creditsPage.realtimeAbnormal_closed_grant_invalid: Closed — the access grant was revoked or expired
creditsPage.realtimeAbnormal_closed_payer_conflict: Closed — the payment account could not be stood on
creditsPage.realtimeAbnormal_closed_payer_unresolved: Closed — the payment account could not be resolved

asyncJobs.title: Async jobs
asyncJobs.description: The async jobs you submitted, with their status, reason and amounts; attribution is fixed at submit and a key expiring changes nothing shown.
asyncJobs.loadFailed: Your async jobs could not be loaded.

ordersPage.title: Orders & credits
ordersPage.description: Your orders, your subscription, and every credit granted to you — each traceable to its source.
ordersPage.ordersEmptyDescription: Orders appear here after a plan is purchased.
ordersPage.ordersUnavailableDescription: No billing provider is configured on this deployment, so there are no orders.
ordersPage.grantsDescription: Where every credit came from, and when it expires.

welcomeBanner.message: Welcome to WorkBuddy. Your first month includes the standard plan's base credits — claim them now!

upgradeDialog.title: Buddy AI plans
upgradeDialog.subtitle: Choose the plan and billing cycle that fits.
upgradeDialog.alreadySubscribed: An active plan is already running; no need to buy another before it ends
upgradeDialog.autoRenew: To continue after this period ends, purchase again (auto-renewal is not available yet)
upgradeDialog.agreement: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service

errors.pendingPurchase: Another purchase is already pending. Finish or cancel it before buying again.
errors.cancelFailed: The order could not be cancelled. Try again shortly.

modelAccess.title: Model access
modelAccess.description: Authorize registered Bots to call models as you. Each authorization comes from your own confirmation of a one-time binding code; you can revoke any of them on its own.
modelAccess.codeDescription: Paste the one-time code the Bot gave you. Nothing is authorized until you confirm what it names.
modelAccess.invalidCode: That binding code is not valid. Ask the Bot for a fresh one and try again.
modelAccess.previewIdentity: It will act as your external identity {{identity}}.
modelAccess.confirmFailed: The authorization could not be created. Try again with a fresh code.
modelAccess.grantedDescription: {{bot}} may now call models as you ({{identity}}).
modelAccess.grantActive: Active. Its key goes to the Bot's server only — never to this page or a chat.
modelAccess.grantedNext: The Bot's server receives its own short-lived key from OpenBot; every call it makes spends your personal credits through this authorization.
modelAccess.yourGrantsDescription: Every Bot you have authorized to call models as you. Revoking one takes effect immediately; consumption that already happened stays settled.
modelAccess.yourGrantsEmpty: No Bots are authorized yet. Confirm a binding code above to authorize one.
modelAccess.revokeAllFailed: The revocation did not complete. Try again shortly.
modelAccess.about: A Bot asks its server for a binding code and hands it to you out of band. The code names one Bot and one external identity, lives for a few minutes, and works exactly once. Confirming here creates the authorization; no key, balance or credits are created with it.

modelPicker.title: Workbench model
modelPicker.description: Choose the model your workbench runs on. A model that becomes unavailable is reported as it is — it is never silently replaced.
modelPicker.unsetDescription: Pick one of the models below to set your default.
modelPicker.unavailableHeading: The selected model is not available.

unavailableReasons.model_capability_mismatch: The model no longer matches the workbench's capabilities.
unavailableReasons.model_not_open: The model is not open for use.
unavailableReasons.model_catalog_stale: The model catalog is out of date.
unavailableReasons.model_not_in_catalog: The model has been removed from the catalog.

modelPicker.reselect: Pick one of the models below to continue.
modelPicker.emptyList: No models are open for selection.
modelPicker.refusalFallback: that model is not selectable right now.
